purpose: Decide whether api.clubelo.com can supply a cross-league club strength signal for club friendlies, and which of its constants are PUBLISHED (citable) versus unpublished (must not be invented).

access.robots_txt: open; no AI-crawler disallow. Contrast footballdatabase.com, which explicitly Disallows ClaudeBot and was therefore ruled out.
access.format: CSV, not JSON — unlike every other provider client in this repo.

GET /Fixtures.VERDICT: UNUSABLE FOR FRIENDLIES. Zero friendly fixtures — every row is a competitive match (ECL/UEL + domestic leagues). Its precomputed goal-difference and scoreline probabilities therefore cannot be reused for a friendly; any friendly estimate must be computed from the day-ranking Elo values instead.

GET /YYYY-MM-DD.VERDICT: USABLE. 589 clubs with Country and Level (league tier) columns — Level is a directly relevant 'level of play' signal.

elo_expectation.dr: Elo point difference between the two clubs
elo_expectation.CRITICAL_SEMANTICS: E is an EXPECTED POINTS SHARE, not P(win). ClubElo's own wording: 'draws counting as half win/half loss'. So E = P(win) + 0.5*P(draw). Reporting E as a win probability would misstate the source.

NOT_published_do_not_invent.hfa_current_value: Per-country and converged daily by an algorithm; the site publishes the UPDATE RULE but never the current value. No HFA is applied by us. Independently, a pre-season friendly is often at a neutral or touring venue, so a home-field term would be questionable here even if the number were published.
NOT_published_do_not_invent.one_x_two_split: 'The match odds are based on a result histogram for the two club's Elo difference.' That histogram is NOT published as a formula. Therefore NO win/draw/loss split is derived for ANY pair — not merely for mixed-source pairs. Only E is reported.

name_matching_measured.method: Automatic tiers only: exact-normalized, then token-set, then unique directional containment. No alias table used for this measurement.

alias_misses_EVIDENCE_BACKED.Internazionale: Inter (ITA, L1). Note containment CORRECTLY refused this: 'Inter' also substring-matches Winterthur and Inter Turku, so an explicit alias is required rather than a looser tier.

genuine_no_coverage.Estrela: Portugal — only 2 Portuguese clubs are in the ranking at all

design_consequences: Compute from the day ranking; /Fixtures is useless for friendlies.
Report E as an expected points share, never as 'win probability'.
Publish no draw probability and no 1X2 split, for any pair.
Apply no home-field term; say so explicitly rather than silently omitting it.
Level + Country give the league-tier and region signal directly.
Aliases are added only from the measured misses above, never from intuition.
